title: QUALIFY and deduplication
summary: QUALIFY can filter window-function results without an extra subquery on engines that support it.

blocks.text: QUALIFY can filter window-function results without an extra subquery on engines that support it.

items: Use a deterministic tie-breaker in ROW_NUMBER.
Do not use DISTINCT as a generic fix for unexplained duplication.
On engines without QUALIFY, wrap the window expression in a CTE/subquery.
Define which record wins when timestamps tie.
